title: Cardholders on a Northgate Membership
content:
**R1. One number, one expiry.** Every card on a membership of Northgate Memberships carries the same membership number and expiry date.

**R2. Active membership.** A card is issued only on a membership whose status is active.

**R3. Household cards.** A household card is issued only while the number of household cards in use — household cards issued on the membership with no later deactivation of that card — is below the tier's number of free household cards. The household cardholder must be at least the tier's minimum household cardholder age and, where the tier requires the same address, live at the primary member's address — the primary member states these facts. The count of cards in use comes from the membership's card records; the age and address come from the primary member's statement.

**R4. Business add-on cards.** A business add-on card is issued only while the number of add-on cards in use — business add-on cards issued with no later deactivation of that card — is below the tier's maximum of add-on cards, and its add-on card fee is charged under the membership fee charging rules.

**R5. Photo.** Where the tier requires a photo, a newly added cardholder's card is activated when the cardholder's photo is taken at any club membership counter; member services records the issuance.

**R6. Replacement cards.** A replacement card is issued only after the lost or stolen card has been deactivated. Member services issues a replacement only while the replacement cards issued in the current membership year (for a lost or stolen card or for a damaged card, from the first day of the year to date) are below the tier's replacement allowance; beyond that the cardholder obtains a replacement in person at a club membership counter with photo ID.

**R7. Who may add or remove.** Only the primary member may add or remove cardholders.

## Judgement table (hypothetical counts, against the tier's allowance)

| Request | Count in use or issued this year | Allowance | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| household card | 0 in use | 1 | may be issued, subject to R2 and R3's age and address |
| household card | 1 in use | 1 | not issued |
| business add-on card | 7 in use | 8 | may be issued, fee charged |
| business add-on card | 8 in use | 8 | not issued |
| replacement through member services | 1 issued this year | 2 | may be issued once the lost card is deactivated |
| replacement through member services | 2 issued this year | 2 | obtained in person at a club membership counter with photo ID |

## Retired clause — no longer in force

"When the primary member removes a business add-on cardholder within the tier's full-refund window of calendar days after that card's add-on fee was charged, the fee is refunded in full as an add-on card removal refund; after that no add-on fee is refunded until the membership itself is cancelled." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.

superseded_clauses: When the primary member removes a business add-on cardholder within full_refund_window_days calendar days after that card's add-on fee was charged, the fee is refunded in full with refund_reason addon_card_removed; after that no add-on fee is refunded until the membership itself is cancelled.
